metrics.coverage: C_R = P(document contains at least one observable feature under R)
metrics.effective_support: N_eff = exp(H(p_feature)) over observed feature mass
metrics.overlap_loss: L_overlap = 1 - total_exclusive_events / total_legacy_hits when R1 exists
metrics.source_channel: report whether canonical text differs from raw-ish/source body and whether that changes feature counts

no_threshold_rule: No universal pass threshold is frozen from the OKHC outcome. These metrics define a validity surface and must accompany geometric claims.
interpretation: Low coverage means many documents are invisible to the representation.
Low N_eff / high D_max means nominally high-dimensional representation has collapsed to a few features.
Geometry from a collapsed representation may be numerically exact yet scientifically non-comparable to another validity region.
Observation/canonicalization channels must be separated from language drift.
consequence: R0/R1 EDF has time-dependent validity regions; pre-1910 and postlib geometry cannot be treated as the same measurement channel without qualification.
